title: Relief band on the Streckfus steamer
summary: His band alternated hour on, hour off with the boat band; he declined to join and played only local excursions.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Oh yeah, I forgot to ask you to go over.
Yeah, I played up there when Faith Marble had his band, Durant and Humphrey. We had Durant and Humphrey at the time we played up there. You know, two bands. Hour on, hour off. Oh, two on the boat?

See the boat had their own band, you know, Faith Marble. So Stratford hired me, hired our band, you know, the relief of them, hour on, hour off. And then after that he heard how I played and everything. And he sent Kimber, you know the best player of Faith?
Yeah, he sent him to my house to try to get me to play, join the band, you know. Well, I didn't want to quit my band, you know. Go play on the boat.
When you played on the boat it was just there at New Orleans, you didn't go up the river
to St. Louis or anything like that? No, no, no. It was a single engagement, you know.
Ever so often they get different bands, you know. Extra boat ride. Yeah, extra boat ride, you know. Yeah. They go further up the river than they usually go, you know.
